principle: Formula is a First-Class Entity (Fresco). At Fresco most knowledge lives as Formula → Ingredients → Role → PSD → Process → Measurements → Performance — NOT as Document → Specifications. A formula sheet is a document; the FORMULA is the knowledge object the lab reasons about.

architecture_shift.note: Spec extraction stays for documents that ARE spec sheets; for formula sheets the Canonical Formula Object is the central knowledge layer. Knowledge Graph / Experiment / Project linking come LATER — only after this schema is stable (Fresco).

maps_to_david: Formula = Chemical System (binders) + PSD Design (psd) + Functional Premix (additives) + Manufacturing Strategy (process). Verified scope: B-4 + Dry Powder.

field_authority._note: The Verified/Interpretation separation, built into the schema. objective = read mechanically from the document (authoritative). interpreted = a provisional heuristic, NOT asserted knowledge. pending = not in a formula sheet; awaits another source (David / experiment / QC doc).
field_authority.formula_id: objective (provisional identity — see identity_status; versioning rule is Q-009, open)
field_authority.version: objective if present in doc; identity semantics pending Q-009
field_authority.ingredients[].role: interpreted (psd_fraction is mechanical; binder/additive are heuristics — provisional)
field_authority.psd[]: objective (a fraction name IS a particle-size range/mesh — mechanical)
field_authority.composition_audit: objective (Σ% self-audit computed from the rows)
field_authority.process: pending (Manufacturing Strategy — not in the formula sheet; David / SOP)
field_authority.quality_checks: objective when the QC block is filled (usually near-empty in these docs)

boundary.identity: formula_id is PROVISIONAL until Q-009 (what change creates a new formula identity) is answered by David. Do not aggregate across formula_id as if it were canonical yet (Law 2: Identity Before Aggregation).
boundary.roles: role / chemical_system / functional_additives are interpreted heuristics — never asserted as derived knowledge. Only objective fields carry authority.
boundary.pending_fields: process / linked_* / observed_effects are declared EMPTY, not guessed. An empty pending field is a known gap, not a value.
